例句

  1. In Japan, women have difficulty getting promoted or returning to their jobs after giving birth and raising their children.
    在日本，女性生完小孩、把孩子帶大之後，很難升遷，也很難回到原本的工作。
  2. I have difficulty remembering names.
    我很難記住名字。
  3. Did you have trouble finding the hotel?
    你找飯店有遇到困難嗎？
  4. Many foreign students have difficulty reading kanji.
    很多外國學生讀漢字有困難。
  5. My grandfather has trouble hearing.
    我爺爺聽東西有困難。
  6. We had difficulty finding a parking space.
    我們很難找到停車位。
  7. Ann had trouble sleeping before the exam.
    Ann 考試前很難睡著。
  8. Do you have difficulty understanding the teacher?
    你聽懂老師的話有困難嗎？
  9. Ms. Lin got promoted to manager last month.
    林小姐上個月升為經理。
  10. Be careful not to get hurt.
    小心不要受傷。
  11. We got lost in Shibuya.
    我們在澀谷迷路了。
  12. My bike got stolen in front of the station.
    我的腳踏車在車站前面被偷了。
  13. Tom got hit by a ball in the park.
    Tom 在公園被球打到了。
  14. Ken got hurt in the soccer game.
    Ken 在足球比賽中受傷了。
  15. Our car got stuck in the snow.
    我們的車卡在雪裡動不了。
  16. Wash your hands before eating.
    吃東西前要洗手。
  17. After finishing my homework, I watched TV.
    寫完功課之後，我看了電視。
  18. Brush your teeth before going to bed.
    睡覺前要刷牙。
  19. After graduating from college, she worked in a bank.
    大學畢業後，她在銀行工作。
  20. He went out after having breakfast.
    他吃完早餐之後出門了。
  21. Before leaving Japan, I bought some presents for my family.
    離開日本前，我買了一些禮物給家人。
  22. After getting promoted, my uncle got very busy.
    升職之後，我叔叔變得很忙。
  23. Some mothers have difficulty returning to work after having a baby.
    有些媽媽生完小孩之後很難回去工作。
  24. Many people have trouble getting up early in winter.
    很多人冬天很難早起。
  25. She got promoted after working at the company for ten years.
    她在公司工作十年之後升職了。
  26. After raising three children, my mother started to study English.
    養大三個孩子之後，我媽媽開始學英文。
  27. I had difficulty getting a taxi after the concert.
    演唱會結束後，我很難叫到計程車。
  28. We had trouble getting to the station after it started to snow.
    開始下雪之後，我們費了很大的力氣才到車站。
  29. We got lost on the way to the hotel.
    我們在去飯店的路上迷路了。
  30. Tom said goodbye before getting on the train.
    Tom 上火車前說了再見。
